name: Thang Long Water Puppet Theatre
nameVi: Nhà hát Múa rối Thăng Long
kicker: The water-puppet theatre by the lake
summary: Watch puppeteers stand waist-deep in water and steer lacquered wooden figures through scenes of village life, a form dating from the 11th century. The Thang Long theatre is at 57b Dinh Tien Hoang, on the east side of Hoan Kiem, so a show fits an evening by the lake.
getThere: Walk the east side of the lake
heroCaption: The Thang Long Water Puppet Theatre
gettingThere: Walk to 57b Dinh Tien Hoang, on the east side of Hoan Kiem Lake.
hours: Check on arrival. Show times are on the theatre website (Vietnam Tourism).
admissionNote: Check on arrival. From 100,000 VND on Vietnam Tourism; no theatre price list confirmed.

body: The stage is a pool of water. Puppeteers stand waist-deep in it and work lacquered wooden figures across the surface, playing rural scenes. At the final act they step out in front of the curtain.
The theatre is at 57b Dinh Tien Hoang, on the east side of Hoan Kiem, so a show fits between the lake walk and dinner in the lanes. It is the family evening in the center.
